_source: docs/design-bible.md: Room tricks and Trick frequency. DC = 10 + PB + floor; damage PB d6 (floors 1-2) or PB d8 (floors 3-4).

tricks.name: Snap-Pillar
tricks.trigger: Stepping on a hairline seam hex
tricks.effect: Dex save or be launched 15 ft into the air, taking PB d6 bludgeoning damage and landing prone.
tricks.counterplay: Perception spots the seam; Athletics or thieves' tools jams it, or push an enemy onto it.

tricks.name: Static Vent
tricks.trigger: Ending a turn within 5 ft of a glowing fissure
tricks.effect: Con save or take PB d6 lightning damage and lose reactions until the start of your next turn.
tricks.counterplay: Cap the vent with a heavy object, or seal it with cold damage.

tricks.name: Shatter-Step
tricks.trigger: Moving more than 15 ft in one turn across tiled stone
tricks.effect: The tiles burst into caltrops: PB piercing damage per 5 ft moved, unless moving at half speed.
tricks.counterplay: Jump the section, teleport, or blast the tiles with an area effect first.

tricks.name: Crushing Columns
tricks.effect: Two rows of pillars slam together across a 10 ft lane. Str or Dex save or take PB d8 bludgeoning damage and be Restrained until the pillars reset.
tricks.counterplay: Dust shows the lane a round early; Arcana or thieves' tools locks a pillar in place.

tricks.name: Ricochet Monolith
tricks.trigger: Any ranged attack or spell within 15 ft of the crystal
tricks.effect: The monolith absorbs it and fires a wild bolt at the nearest creature within 30 ft for PB d6 force damage.
tricks.counterplay: Shatter the crystal (AC 14, 4 × PB HP) for a 10 ft burst on nearby enemies.

tricks.name: Magnetic Floor
tricks.trigger: Wearing metal armor or wielding metal weapons in the zone
tricks.effect: Speed is halved, and at the end of the turn you're pulled 10 ft toward the center lodestone.
tricks.counterplay: Disarm the lodestone runes (Arcana or thieves' tools) to reverse polarity and hurl enemies away.

tricks.name: Gate Shear
tricks.trigger: Any creature in the room becomes Bloodied
tricks.effect: The floor splits along a 5 ft chasm of raw stride energy. Creatures on the line make a Dex save or take PB d8 force damage and fall into the trench.
tricks.counterplay: Knock down a column to bridge the chasm and splash energy onto adjacent enemies.

tricks.name: Stride Vent
tricks.trigger: Casting a leveled spell or using a bonus action within 20 ft
tricks.effect: A vent erupts under the caster at the end of their turn: Dex save or take PB d8 force damage and be Blinded by the flash until the end of their next turn.
tricks.counterplay: Bait the vent and step away, leaving a charged pool for enemies.

tricks.name: Gravity Inversion Tile
tricks.trigger: Stepping onto a gravity rune tile
tricks.effect: Str save or fall upward 30 ft to the ceiling, taking falling damage and staying stuck there until you crawl off the tile's column.
tricks.counterplay: Push enemies onto the tile to take melee threats off the floor.

tricks.name: Unseen Aperture
tricks.trigger: Ending a turn in a corner no ally can see
tricks.effect: Jaws bite from negative space: Wis save or take PB d8 psychic or force damage and be teleported to a random space in the room.
tricks.counterplay: Keep sightlines on allies, or isolate an enemy in a corner to trigger it on them.

tricks.name: Looping Corridor
tricks.trigger: Moving within 5 ft of the room's outer boundary
tricks.effect: You wrap to the opposite wall with momentum intact and take PB d8 force damage unless you pass an Acrobatics or Arcana check.
tricks.counterplay: Shove enemies through the boundary into the opposite wall's hazards.

tricks.name: Memory Drain
tricks.trigger: Starting a turn within 15 ft of a weeping statue
tricks.effect: Int or Cha save or take PB d8 necrotic damage and lose one random Level 1 to 3 boon until the statue is destroyed.
tricks.counterplay: Destroy the statue (AC 16, 6 × PB HP) for a shockwave that stuns nearby enemies.
